seo.title: Coaching – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Personal triathlon coaching: training planned in TrainingPeaks and adjusted daily when needed. Available daily from 6am to 10pm, replies within 3 hours.

title: Coaching
lead: Sports science is the foundation, the person is at the centre. That's why there are only a few places, so every athlete gets truly personal support. The path from the first run to the first long distance in 8:40 hours was entirely self-planned.

offer.title: 1:1 Coaching
offer.text: Your training is planned individually in TrainingPeaks, your sessions are reviewed and we stay in close contact. If you're tired, have a last-minute business trip or feel really good, the plan is adjusted. Day by day if needed.
features: Available daily from 6am to 10pm, replies within 3 hours
Regular review of your training data
Before every race: pacing, nutrition and tactics
offer.note: Only a few places, so there's enough time for every athlete.

philosophyText: The focus is on sustainable development in sport, which is why long-term collaboration is ideal. Only then can health and athletic development go hand in hand.
philosophyQuote: Keep the easy days easier than easy and the hard days sustainably hard.

process.title: We get to know each other
process.text: The free intro call is about where you are, your goals and how the coaching works.

process.title: Analysis
process.text: If you already train with a watch or bike computer, your previous data is reviewed.

process.title: We get going
process.text: You get your plan in TrainingPeaks and load sessions straight to your watch and bike computer.

process.title: We keep at it
process.text: You give feedback, the plan is adjusted. That's what makes the difference in the end.

faq.question: How quickly do you reply?
faq.answer: Within 3 hours, every day between 6am and 10pm.

faq.question: Why only a few athletes?
faq.answer: Because every athlete should be known well. If something becomes too much, it should be noticed before it shows up in the data. That only works with regular contact.

faq.question: How long do we work together?
faq.answer: Ideally for the long term. Sustainable progress takes time, and the longer the collaboration, the better it's possible to judge what works for you.

faq.question: Why TrainingPeaks?
faq.answer: Because it simply works. You see your sessions on your phone, they sync to your watch, and straight after training it's clear how it went.

faq.question: What does day-by-day planning mean?
faq.answer: When your life needs it, the week isn't planned in advance. Instead we look at what makes sense each day.

faq.question: Who is the coaching for?
faq.answer: Anyone who takes triathlon seriously and wants close support. Whether you're just starting out or planning your next full distance.
